name: quick-fix-openrouter
title: Quick Fix (OpenRouter)
description: Fix spelling and grammar of selected text with your chosen OpenRouter model and provider.
author: erikmay

commands.name: quick-fix
commands.title: Quick Fix Selected Text
commands.description: Fixes spelling and grammar of the selected text and pastes the corrected version back in place.

commands.name: quick-fix-submit
commands.title: Quick Fix and Submit
commands.description: Fixes the selected text, pastes it back, and presses Return to send it, for example a chat message.

preferences.name: openRouterApiKey
preferences.title: OpenRouter API Key
preferences.description: Used to send text to your selected model and provider through OpenRouter.

preferences.name: openRouterModel
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: OpenRouter model ID, such as openai/gpt-6.1-sol. Check openrouter.ai/models for available IDs.

preferences.name: providerSlug
preferences.title: Provider Slug
preferences.description: Allow only this OpenRouter provider. Find its slug on the model's Providers page; requests fail if it cannot serve the model.

preferences.name: reasoningEffort
preferences.title: Reasoning Effort
preferences.description: Automatic keeps minimal reasoning for the default model and uses the model's default otherwise.
